name: Lydia Rokossovski
original_name: リディア・ロコソフスキ
source:
18 years old. Admiral of the Soviet army. She is bright and lively. [spoiler]She was deployed a week prior she ought to execute "order of pregnancy" and was taken prisoner of war by Japan after the battle by Siberia. After her Red Book was taken she saw through the shroud of her blind faith in sharism and joined the Japanese fleet.[/spoiler]

Once she went to planet Aomori to vacation and became acquainted with some farmer. She is in touch with his grandmother even now.

Likes: apples.
Hates: people that stinks with alcohol.

"Jeez, what a bad timing they chose, eh. And I was really waiting for it."
